sentences.text: (Per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao)

This writ petition is filed praying to grant the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus directing 3rd Respondent to produce the detenue i.e., Biswakarma Subash Babu, now detained in Central Prison Hyderabad at Chanchalguda, before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impunged detention order passed by the 2nd Respondent vide SB(I)No.193/PD4/HYD/2021 dated 26-06-2021 and approved by the 1st Respondent as being illegal, arbitrary, improper, unilateral,
unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant..."

2. Heard Sri Pasham Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home, appearing for the respondents.
3.

This writ petition is filed challenging the detention order dated 26.06.2021 made under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders,
Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986) as confirmed by the Government vide G.O.Rt.No.2058 dated 09.09.2021.
4.

entities.text:
Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders,
Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The detaining authority relied on Crime No.24 of 2021 in Sanjeevareddy Nagar Police Station,
Crime No.12 of 2021 in Ramgopalpet Police Station, Crime No.10 of 2021 in Mirchowk Police Station, Crime No.5 of 2021 in Market Police Station, Crime Nos.15 and 16 of 2021 in Gopalapuram Police Station, registered against the detenu under Section 382 of Indian Penal Code (IPC) to resort to preventive detention.

entities.text: Ramgopalpet Police Station, Crime No.10 of 2021
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Market Police Station, Crime Nos.15 and 16 of 2021
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: All the six crimes were related to snatching of mobile phones.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner placed reliance on earlier decisions of this Court in W.P.Nos.19296 and 17307 of 2020, W.P.No.28524 of 2019 and W.P.No.16599 of 2019, wherein this Court has held that resorting to preventive detention on routine law and order offences like snatching of mobile phones is not warranted and amounts to arbitrary exercise of power and authority.

6. Learned Government Pleader fairly submits that the reasons assigned for detention are identical to the reasons assigned in the earlier detention orders which were subject matter of challenge in those writ petitions.

7. In view of the same and following the decisions of this Court in W.P.Nos.19296 and 17307 of 2020, W.P.No.28524 of 2019 and W.P.No.16599 of 2019, this writ petition is also allowed and the impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Hyderabad City - 2nd respondent vide SB(I).No.193/PD-4/HYD/2021 dated 26.06.2021 and the consequential Biswakarma Pooja vs The State Of Telangana on 3 March, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29808278/
2 confirmation order of the Principal Secretary, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order)
Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad -1st respondent approving the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.2058,
General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department dated 09.09.2021, are hereby set aside.
